metricCode.description:
The code of the metric that's being ignored or re-enabled. If no code is
specified, the Code Analyzer is disabled (or enabled) entirely.

line.description: The line number where the exclusion message locates.

column.description: The column number where the exclusion message locates.

kind.description: The enum value indicating if the directive enables or disables the metric.

title:
The Type that contains information about a directive to disable or reenable
{@link BaseCodeAnalysis.Metric}s for certain lines of code.

The following directives are supported:

| Directive Kind                  | Description                                                               |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `c3-analysis-disable`           | Disable selected code analysis metrics.                                   |
| `c3-analysis-enable`            | Reenable selected code analysis metrics if they were previously disabled. |
| `c3-analysis-disable-next-line` | Disable selected code analysis metrics for the next line.                 |
name: BaseCodeAnalysis.Metric.Directive
